heat_status: Tropical Pacific - With an expected El Niño event in Boreal winter, MHW likelihoods throughout the remainder of 2026 are very high in the Eastern Tropical Pacific (90-100% [80-100%]; high confidence) and low in the western Tropical Pacific (0-20% [0-10%]; medium confidence) | Northeast Pacific - High MHW likelihoods are forecast off the California and Baja California coasts through the end of the year (80-90% [60-80%]; medium confidence), with lower but still elevated likelihoods off Oregon and Washington (40-70% [30-50%]; low-medium confidence). | Central and Western North Pacific - Forecast MHWs probabilities across the central and western North Pacific decline but remain elevated through August (40-70% [30-50%]; low confidence).
